title: Best Nail Polish (2026)
summary: The best nail polishes of 2026 combine performance, safety, and style, with OPI and Olive & June standing out for their repeated praise across multiple reviews.
method: Selected products from the provided sources, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one site (OPI, Olive & June). Additional top picks were added from single-source reviews to round out a 5‑product list.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source lists them; otherwise the price field is null. No external pricing or discount information was added.

products.name: OPI Nail Lacquer
why: OPI Nail Lacquer was highlighted in Good Housekeeping as the best nail polish, praised for its reliability and chip‑proof performance.
The product is also mentioned in Glazeme.com.au as part of the best performance‑to‑price ratio for regular polish, underscoring its broad appeal.
products.best_for: Anyone seeking a dependable, salon‑quality polish for everyday wear
products.skip_if: You prefer a non‑toxic formula or a budget option

products.name: Olive & June Nail Polish
why: Olive & June is celebrated in Allure for its long‑lasting, non‑toxic formula that resists chipping for up to two weeks.
HealthStartsInTheKitchen.com also praises it as the best non‑toxic nail polish, noting its vibrant colors and safety profile.
specs: Best Shade Range: Olive & June Long Lasting Nail Polish
cons: Higher price than some drugstore brands
products.best_for: Users prioritizing clean beauty without sacrificing durability
products.skip_if: You need a wide color palette or a very low budget
products.amazon_listing: Olive & June Long Lasting Nail Polish, Obsessed

products.name: Essie Gel Couture Nail Polish
why: Allure lists Essie Gel Couture as the best overall long‑lasting nail polish, noting its resistance to chipping and fading.
The review highlights its ease of removal compared to traditional gel, making it user‑friendly.
pros: Up to two weeks of wear
products.best_for: Those who want salon‑quality durability at home
products.skip_if: You lack a curing lamp or prefer a quick‑dry formula
products.amazon_listing: Essie Gel Couture Longwear Nail Polish Kit, Sheer Nude Pink, Fairy Tailor + Top Coat, 0.46

products.name: S&L Gel Polish
why: SLBeautyCo’s review names S&L as the best overall gel polish, citing its color accuracy and flawless finish.
The product also scores high on curing time and chip resistance.
cons: Can be harsh on nails if overused
products.best_for: Nail techs and enthusiasts seeking professional gel results
products.skip_if: You prefer a non‑gel formula or lack a curing lamp

products.name: Sally Hansen Nail Polish
why: Glazeme.com.au lists Sally Hansen as a reliable brand under $15, offering solid performance for budget shoppers.
The review notes its consistent quality across multiple shades.
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious consumers looking for dependable polish
products.skip_if: You require a non‑toxic or high‑performance formula
